system.description:
You carry a knapsack that contains a seemingly endless supply of stuff and knick knacks. The knapsack is a HEAVY item (@JournalEntry[Character Creation]).
The GM should only allow a Peddler to create something when it is about to be used, and when it is not to be used, it instead costs no WP, a drawn tool will then simply be the same piece every time you draw it... and if you later have no WP when you are in real need of it, you have simply lost it.

✥ RANK 1: When you spend WP, you can find almost any item from the list of trade goods (see @JournalEntry[Trade Goods]). It cannot be a HEAVY object and it cannot cost more than 1 piece of silver per WP spent.

✥ RANK 2: As per RANK 1, but you can also find a weapon (from the weapon tables) in your knapsack.

✥ RANK 3: As per RANK 2, but the item can cost up to 1 piece of gold per WP spent.

COMMENT: Once you have pulled an item from your knapsack, you must write it down on your character sheet, and you cannot put it back in your knapsack again. If you lose your knapsack, you must get a new one before you can use this talent again. This requires a visit to a trading post of some kind and that you spend a WP and [[/r 2d6]] silver.

✥ RANK 4: You can now have one or more stashes (likely in wagons or stores). A stash takes up 25 units of weight, so you likely need a wagon or other location to store it. To gain one you also need to visit to a trading post. Your first stash is free, but if you need to regain one, you have to spend a WP and [[/r 2d6]] gold. You may from your stash pull heavy objects, shields, armors, clothes, raw materials and tools, in addition to the options available from your knapsack.
✥ RANK 5: When drawing an item, you may either draw it as a masterwork item, with a +1 bonus, or double the value of your WP, so that each WP counts as if worth 2 gold.

You are a natural @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.A6nMThgWXLeqh4dd]{leader}. To use these powers, your allies have to be able to understand you.

✥ RANK 1: As a Fast Action, you may shout a command for something that can be taken as a Fast Action. Up to an amount of party members equal to the WP spent, may immediately take this action as a Free Action, temporarily breaking the turn order. The party members with lowest initiative acts first.

✥ RANK 2: As a fast reaction, you may make a Performance roll to reduce the effect of a fear attack, on a one-[x]-for-one-[x] ratio. You may affect a number of allies within S equal to the amount of WP spent. If you are also affected by the fear attack, you take any damage to EMP instead of WIT.

✥ RANK 3: As per RANK 1, but the command can be for something that can be taken as a Slow Action.

✥ RANK 4: As per RANK 3, but you may spend an additional WP to add a +2 modifier to the actions taken.

✥ RANK 5: As per RANK 4, but when allies take the extra action, any skill roll associated with that action uses their full amount of attribute dice, even if that attribute has been reduced by damage.

You can hit anything with a thrown rock.
The throwing arm talent stacks with other weapon talents (like @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.GX5ym6zRrNKckQ3C]{axe fighter}) when you throw your weapons.

✥ RANK 1: Your attack rolls are modified by +1 when you use a thrown weapon or a sling.

✥ RANK 2: You can throw incredibly far. All attacks with a thrown weapon or a sling have L.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: Attacks with thrown weapons become Fast Actions. Most melee weapons can now be thrown at N as a Slow Action, they then also benefit from the bonus die from this talent. If you combine a sling and a staff into a staff sling, you can fight with that, counting as holding both weapons at the same time, without any added penalties.
✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You excel at fighting with one hand free.

✥ RANK 1: Your attack rolls are modified by +1 when you use a one-handed weapon and have your other hand free.

✥ RANK 2: Your parry actions are also modified.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 artifact die.

✥ RANK 4: Your disarm actions are also modified.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

While some people think that killing people from behind is disgraceful, you instead see it as effective.

✥ RANK 1: When you perform a sneak attack (see PHB, page 90), then if you use a light melee weapon, you may use Sleight of Hand instead of Melee to perform it. If you do use Sleight of Hand, the attack ignores your victim’s armor.

✥ RANK 2: Your Sleight of Hand sneak attacks that inflicts at least one point of damage, makes your target unable to speak or run away during his upcoming round.

✥ RANK 3: Your Sleight of Hand sneak attacks that inflicts at least one point of damage, also becomes an opposed roll vs the targets Endurance. If the roll isn’t successfully opposed (reduced to zero [x]), the target is automatically broken and suffers a critical injury. Monsters are immune.

✥ RANK 4: When attacking someone who is either unaware of your presence, or engaged in combat with a third party at A, your attacks inflict an additional +1 damage.

✥ RANK 5: Ranged weapons can now be used to make Sleight of Hand sneak attacks, as long as they are used at a maximum of S.

You throw yourself into combat without any concern for the risk involved. Requires no standing enemy at A. Target enemy at one length above weapon’s reach.

✥ RANK 1: When you move from N to A you can, as the same action, SLASH, STAB, PUNCH, or SHOVE. This is called a CHARGE (Slow Action).

✥ RANK 2: Your attack is modified by +1 when you CHARGE.

✥ RANK 3: When you CHARGE, you can add a d8 Artifact Die to the roll instead of the +1.

✥ RANK 4: You may charge as a Fast Action.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a rock in the heat of battle, immovable and hard to kill. This talent affects how you PARRY attacks, regardless of whether you do it with a shield or a weapon.

✥ RANK 1: When a friend within N is attacked, you can spend a WP to PARRY the attack for him. Your PARRY follows the normal rules and counts as one of your actions in the round. Any unparried damage continues to the intended target, not you.

✥ RANK 2: When you PARRY, you can immediately spend a WP to not count the PARRY against your actions in the round, making it. You can do this several times in a round, as long as you have WP to spend.

✥ RANK 3: When you PARRY successfully, you can decrease damage further by spending WP. Every point you spend decreases damage by one. You must state how many WP you use before you roll for armor.

✥ RANK 4: You may spend a WP to be allowed to parry a monster attack.

✥ RANK 5: You may combine any two ranks from this talent and doing so cost you 1 less WP.

Halflings are Small. Goblins and Halflings are considerably smaller than humans. This means that they can comfortably ride pony’s and wolves. However, all non-light 2-handed weapons impose a -1 move penalty. Heavy weapons can only be wielded using both hands and the combination 2-handed + heavy weapons cannot be used at all.

✥ RANK 1: You can spend WP in combat to avoid being hit by physical attacks . Every WP spent eliminates one [x] the attacker rolls.

✥ RANK 2: Once per QD you can take a Turn (15 minutes) to restore 1 WIT and EMP.

✥ RANK 3: Good fortune. Spend 1 WP to reroll an attribute die showing a [l], or 2 WP to reroll any other die that shows a [l], and has a detrimental effect on a [l].

✥ RANK 4: As long as you have at least 2 WP, treat all untrained skills as if they had a skill level of 1.

✥ RANK 5: As long as you have at least 3 WP, gain a +1 bonus to all skills. This effect stacks with RANK 4.

You don’t need weapons to strike down your enemy.

✥ RANK 1: All your unarmed attacks are modified by +1.

✥ RANK 2: You can headbutt your enemy. It counts as a normal unarmed attack, but it is a Fast Action.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: You may headbutt, kick or pummel your enemy as a Free Action. You may only make one such attack per turn.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a master shooter and fire bullets as if they were controlled by your own will.

✥ RANK 1: When you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you can spend a WP to find a weakness in your opponent’s armor or natural armor. The armor offers no protection against your attack.

✥ RANK 2: Once you have used up all your actions during the round, you can spend a WP to immediately attack again using a ranged weapon. However, said weapon must have been PREPARED earlier, and you can only do this once per round.

✥ RANK 3: When you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you can increase the damage. Every WP spent increases damage by one. You must state how many WP you use before your opponent rolls for any armor.

✥ RANK 4: If you wound with a ranged attack, you can spend WP, to add a shove or disarm effect. Each WP adds 1 [x] towards the selected effect. It costs you no WP if the target resists the effect, for instance if the target has the talents @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.pFlXU9GsjMCpRQwk]{firm grip} or @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.D11eGJDfhCk8e7ut]{steady feet}. Cannot be used on monsters.

✥ RANK 5: If you wound with a ranged attack, you can spend 1 WP to have it deal an automatic critical injury. Cannot be used on monsters.

Dragonslayer is the title given to those who seek honor and fame by killing beasts and monsters.

✥ RANK 1: All your attacks against monsters are modified by +1.

✥ RANK 2: Your attacks against monsters cause 1 additional point of damage.

✥ RANK 3: Replace +1 with a d8 Artifact Die to your roll in attacks against monsters.

✥ RANK 4: Attacks against monsters deal 2 extra points of damage, instead of 1.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a master of disguise and can easily assume the appearance of others. Now requires a Disguise Kit. This is a normal weighted item, that you initially get for free. However, if you lose it, you must get a new one before you can use this talent again. This requires a visit to a trading post of some kind and that you spend a WP and [[/r 2d6]] silver.

✥ RANK 1: By spending a WP and preparing for a moment, you can assume the appearance of another person, but not their voice or demeanor. The person must be of the same sex and kin as you are. Anyone who knows the person and sees you at N can discover your ruse by rolling Insight. Every extra WP you spend when you create your disguise modifies any roll to see through it by –1.

✥ RANK 2: As per RANK 1, but you can also mimic voices and demeanors. If you talk to someone who knows the person you are imitating, he can see through your disguise as per RANK 1 above.

✥ RANK 3: You can assume another person’s appearance completely, even if they are of the opposite sex or another kin. In other respects, treat this the same as per RANK 2.

✥ RANK 4: You may also apply RANK 1 to anyone other than yourself, for 1 WP per person. Does your GM only allow RANK 3 impersona-
tions of kin of your size? If so, then you may now, by using stilts (normal size object), assume the size of kins larger than yourself.
✥ RANK 5: If you use stilts as described in RANK 4, you may, given enough time to prepare, assume the size of something larger that is not even humanoid, like a giant spider or an Ent.

✥ RANK 1 (Гвирл): Гибкость и выживание Потратив 1 WP вы можете заменить один навык в проверке на другой (характеристика остается той же). Замена должна быть хотя бы немного логичной и подходящей. 
При желании вы можете выбрать хар-ку для расы, отличную от EMP.
✥ RANK 1 (Конкист): Несгибаемая воля Потратив 1 WP вы можете выкрикнуть (Fast Action) указание или приказ союзникам в N от вас. Считается, что вы помогаете им в их следующем действии (Slow Action/Fast Action) в этой сцене.

✥ RANK 2: (Гвирл): Взаимовыручка Потратив 1 WP вы можете заменить кубы помощи (вам или от вас) следующей проверки с d6 на d8.
✥ RANK 2: (Конкист): Ценность жизни Вы можете потратить остаток ваших WP (не меньше 2) чтобы заставить врага, атакующего вас, перебросить все [x] проверки (оставляя прочие кости как есть).

✥ RANK 3: (Гвирл): Адаптивность При использовании RANK 1 вы можете при желании заменить и характеристику, и навык на любой на выбор. Замена обоих стоит 2 WP.
✥ RANK 3: (Конкист): Светская подготовка При использовании навыка с RANK 3 или выше (до броска) вы можете потратить 1 WP чтобы автоматически добавить себе [x] для этой проверки. Эту проверку нельзя будет Push впоследствии.

✥ RANK 4: (Гвирл): Горькая жила Вы можете потратить 1 WP, чтобы полностью игнорировать негативные эффекты состояний Hungry, Thirsty и Cold на 1 QD.
✥ RANK 4: (Конкист): Личный пример Если любой ваш навык имеет RANK больше, чем у вашего союзника в S, этот союзник получает +1 к проверкам этого навыка.

✥ RANK 5: (Гвирл): Надежда человечества +1 к значению любой характеристики.
✥ RANK 5: (Конкист): "Слово - Власть" Потратив 1 WP, вы можете немедленно восстановить всем союзникам в пределах слышимости 1 ед. WIT или EMP на выбор (Slow Action).

You can read people like others read books.
✥ RANK 1: When you use Insight to read people you can with extra [x], get hints about that person’s motivations, background, and things that they are hiding. The GM should describe what clues you spot that make you think this.

✥ RANK 2: You get a +1 modification when you use Insight to read people or when opposing Manipulation.

✥ RANK 3: People cannot roll Insight to read you (as RANK 1). If they try to, you can lead them astray, by giving them false/made up readings.

✥ RANK 4: You can add a d8 Artifact Die when you use Insight to read people or when opposing Manipulation.

✥ RANK 5: Switch the d8 die to a d12 die. When you read people, you also discern their RANK in this talent, if any.

You have practiced with a sword in hand since you were a child. Any extra attacks count as Free Actions, and as such they do not benefit from general talents

✥ RANK 1: Your attack and PARRY rolls are modified by +1 when you fight with a sword.

✥ RANK 2: You can SLASH two enemies with your sword with a single action. Roll separately for the two attacks. If you use hidden combinations (see @JournalEntry[Advanced Close Combat]), the second attack occurs outside of the combination.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: You can slash up to three enemies with your sword with a single action. Any extra attacks still count as Free Actions, and as such they do not benefit from general talents.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d10 die.

You are a very smooth talker. Your words are simply irresistible. Path of influence only works if neither side has taken any hostile actions and the target must be able to clearly understand you (speak your language). It cannot be used on Monsters.
✥ RANK 1: You may spend a WP to improve the attitude of anyone towards yourself. An attitude can only be changed once and by one step, using this power and cannot be used against someone that is directly hostile, but the effect is otherwise permanent. Attitude can change from dislike, to indifferent, to friendly. If your previous actions are a cause for any dislike, a target can resist this with an Insight roll. Someone who is friendly wishes you well, and will help you, and can often take small risks to do so. Someone who is dislikes you wishes you ill, and can take small risks to harm you.
✥ RANK 2: As RANK 1, but can be directed towards someone else or towards a group, and can now also lower the attitude and can even go from dislike to openly hostile.

✥ RANK 3: As RANK 2, but you can change the attitude of a whole group at once.

✥ RANK 4: You may plant a feeling of hopelessness by taking to someone for a turn. Spend any amount of WP, the target takes this as EMP damage, resisted by an Insight roll. If this breaks the target, they cannot choose to fight, they just want to be alone. If they were already low in morale, they are likely to commit suicide, otherwise they will ponder their options and recuperate after some rest.

✥ RANK 5: As RANK 3, but up to two WP can be spent, moving the attitude up to two steps.

ЭЛЬФ: Связь багрового камня Тратя WP, вы можете впасть в медитацию (заменяет сон) на 1 QD, во время которого вас не должны тревожить. После выхода из медитации вы получаете все преимущества сна, а также можете дополнительно восстановить [[/r 1d2]] ед. одной любой характеристики и уменьшить наполовину время восстановления любой нелетальной Critical Trauma.

✥ RANK 1 (Сенхедир): Изящество При выполнении Move вы можете потратить 1 WP (перед броском) чтобы автоматически получить [x]. Эту проверку впоследствии нельзя Push.
✥ RANK 1 (Аркандар): Взрывная мощь Ваша расовая характеристика: STR. При совершении действий, зависящих от вашей физической силы, вы можете потратить 1 WP, чтобы получить бонус +3.

✥ RANK 2: (Общее):  Изменчивость Потратив 1 WP вы можете во время медитации вы можете отнять из одной любой характеристики и добавить в любую другую 1 ед. Итоговое значение характеристик не может быть ниже 2 и выше лимита для вашего класса.

✥ RANK 3: (Сенхедир): Воспоминания Во время медитации вы можете обратиться к воспоминаниям прошлого. За 1 WP вы можете спросить мастера о месте, персоне или предмете. Он расскажет легенду, последнее известное местонахождение или что-либо другое об истории или происхождении предмета вопроса. Возможно, что спрашивая о чем-то незначительном или абсолютно неизвестном вы не узнаете ничего нового.
✥ RANK 3: (Аркандар): Окровавленная воля Если вы получаете урон по STR от внешних источников, вы получаете 1 WP (не чаще 1 раза в раунд).

✥ RANK 4: (Общее): Восстановление камня При медитации вы можете потратить 1 WP чтобы получить +1 к проверкам любого атрибута на 1 день/до следующей медитации. Кроме того, вы можете исцелить свою Permanent Critical Injury, если во время медитаций суммарно потратите на это 20 WP (ведите подсчет).

✥ RANK 5: (Сенхедир): При использовании RANK 4 вы можете потратить до 3 WP / хар-ку, чтобы получить такой же бонус к проверкам. Кроме того, при вхождении в медитацию вы можете дополнительно потратить 1 WP чтобы она заняла 15 минут и вместо обычных бонусов полностью восстановила AGI (все еще считается медитацией).
✥ RANK 5: (Аркандар): Багровый перегруз Потратив 3 WP, вы можете немедленно совершить (Slow Action | Charge) @UUID[Compendium.world.talents.Item.1opXrdpFFhh95EBe]{Melee Charge} или совершить обычную атаку оружием Fast Action; этим действием вы наносите удвоенный урон оружия. После совершения действия вы получаете 1 ед. урона STR. Кроме того, медитация полностью восстанавливает все ваши характеристики.

When others try to affect you, you are as immovable as a mighty oak in the wind.

✥ RANK 1: Your Insight roll is modified by +1 when someone attempts to MANIPULATE you.

✥ RANK 2: You can add a d8 Artifact Die to your roll when someone MANIPULATES you.

✥ RANK 3: You cannot be MANIPULATED.

✥ RANK 4: You may roll Insight as a fast reaction to halve the Power Level you feel from a magical effect, round down. You get no roll if you were the source of the spell.

✥ RANK 5: RANK 4 is now a free reaction once per round. You now automatically succeed to resist all spells that can be resisted by rolling Insight.

You recognize patterns in tracks, injuries, movement, and attacks. The longer the hunt continues, the fewer surprises remain to the quarry.

HUNT TARGET: A Hunt Target is a specific monster, a pack of creatures of the same kind, or an unknown creature responsible for the evidence being investigated. To designate a Hunt Target, you must have seen it, examined a fresh track or victim, obtained a sample, or received a sufficiently detailed account. You may have only one Hunt Target at a time. Changing it outside combat takes one Turn.

STUDIED QUARRY: A Hunt Target becomes Studied after you spend at least one Turn examining relevant evidence and succeed with an appropriate skill roll. Use Scouting for tracks and attack sites, Survival for territory and behavior, Lore for records and supernatural nature, Healing for anatomy and remains, or Crafting for mechanisms, shells, and artificial creatures. For every additional [x], you may ask the GM one practical question about the quarry. The answer must be concrete and useful.

✥ RANK 1: When you make a roll to study the Hunt Target, you may spend WP after seeing the result. Each WP spent is converted into one automatic [x].

✥ RANK 2: After successfully studying the Hunt Target, spend one Turn and 1 to 3 WP. For each WP spent, place one d8 in a shared Hunt Pool. Any party member may expend one die from the pool after making a roll directly against the Hunt Target or one of its abilities, then roll and add that die to the result. No more than one Hunt Pool die may be added to the same roll. Unused dice disappear when the hunt ends, the Hunt Target changes, or one day passes.

✥ RANK 3: When the GM rolls on the Studied Quarry's monster attack table, you may spend 1 WP after seeing the result. The GM rerolls the attack, and the new result must be used. You may use this effect once per round.

✥ RANK 4: After the Studied Quarry has used a particular monster attack or special ability at least once, you may spend 1 WP to declare that attack analyzed. Until the encounter ends, choose one appropriate benefit against it: you get d10 to DODGE, PARRY, or another resistance roll; its direct Damage to you is reduced by 1 (no less than 1); its Poison or Disease Virulence is reduced by 2; its Fear Attack produces one fewer [x]; or the duration of a condition it causes is halved. Only one attack may be analyzed at a time. Spend 1 WP to replace it with another previously observed attack. You can spend additional WP to give the same benefit to an equal amount of your allies.

✥ RANK 5: At the start of a round, you may spend 1 WP. Until the end of that round, whenever the Studied Quarry rolls on its monster attack table, the GM rolls twice and you choose which result is used. This effect may be combined with ranks 3 and 4.

You know how to steer rafts and boats over unknown waters. All modifier/Artifact dice from this talent also applies when taking the survey the lands action from a boat while in a water hex.

✥ RANK 1: Your Survival roll is modified by +1 when you LEAD THE WAY at sea (see @JournalEntry[Journeys]).

✥ RANK 2: Life at sea is soothing to you. A QD spent LEADING THE WAY on a boat counts as REST for you.

✥ RANK 3: Replace the +1 modification with a d8 Artifact Die.

✥ RANK 4: As long as you continuously succeed to lead the way at sea, your party of adventurers may travel up to two extra hexagons this QD.

✥ RANK 5: Replace the d8 die with a d12 die.

You practice an unorthodox close combat fighting style.
✥ RANK 1: When you shove, grapple or break free, you can spend WP which are automatically turned into extra [x]. You may even roll first and spend WP after you see how the roll goes.
✥ RANK 2: You may spend 1 WP to roll your full number of dice, even when damaged. The effect lasts a day or until you are broken.
✥ RANK 3: When rolling for Endurance, you can spend WP which are automatically turned into extra [x]. You may even roll first and spend WP after you see how the roll goes.

✥ RANK 4: If you are broken, you may immediately spend WP to not be able to count as broken or unconscious, and keep your
full allotment of actions, for a number of rounds equal to the WP spent. During these rounds, you roll your full number of attribute dice (even when damaged) and may reduce any damage received by 1. It does not protect you from any critical injuries, so those can still kill you. Each critical hit taken also reduces the duration by 1 round. It doesn’t hinder you from pushing any rolls, but only gain WP from that reduce an attribute.

✥ RANK 5: You may spend WP to enhance your STR or AGI by up to 3 points each for a turn (15 minutes). When the turn ends, any damage taken will spill over to your regular attributes, but will not reduce you below 1.

Вы считаете, что нет ничего важнее, чем забота о будущих поколениях. Вы не можете изучить этот талант при создании персонажа.

✥ RANK 1: Ваш следующий персонаж получает дополнительное очко навыка при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт увеличивается на 1.

✥ RANK 2: Ваш следующий персонаж получает дополнительное очко таланта при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 2.

✥ RANK 3: Ваш следующий персонаж получает два дополнительных очка таланта при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 3.

✥ RANK 4: Ваш следующий персонаж получает дополнительное очко таланта при генерации. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 4.

✥ RANK 5: Ваш следующий персонаж получает четыре дополнительных очка таланта при генерации и может вкладывать очки навыков в любые навыки до уровня 4. Ваш базовый опыт дополнительно увеличивается на 5.

Your horse (or another riding animal) is your closest friend and companion, and will help you if you are in trouble.

✥ RANK 1: If you spend a WP when you are Broken (see @JournalEntry[Damage & Recovery]), your horse will stay by your side and defend you. The horse will attack any opponents that attempt to attack or move you.

✥ RANK 2: Your horse can help you get up on your feet when you are Broken. For every WP you spend, you recover one point of the attribute that has been reduced to zero. You cannot use this effect if you are not Broken. An Orc may treat the first WP spent as if two.

✥ RANK 2: When you are mounted, you can spend a WP to escape from combat without rolling dice (see @JournalEntry[Combat]). All other limitations apply.

✥ RANK 3: You can coax your mount into running at breakneck speed for a short period of time. Every WP you spend increases the mount’s Movement Rate (see @JournalEntry[Combat]) one step, but only during one round.

✥ RANK 4: When you use RANK 1 of this talent, it affects all allies you are riding with.

✥ RANK 5: When riding, you may spend WP to add [x] to any skill roll, as long as you can justify why doing the skill while as one with your mount, would do you good. You may do this after seeing the results of the roll.
